basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old bioinformatics researcher based in Boston, MA. My passion lies in unraveling the mysteries of genetic coding and non-coding regions. I hold a PhD in Bioinformatics from MIT, and I've been working in a mid-sized biotech firm for the past five years. Outside of work, I enjoy watching South Park and exploring new technological advancements. I'm a night owl, typically online from 9 PM to midnight. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or attending local science meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive background in bioinformatics, having focused on genetic sequencing and data analysis during my academic career. My expertise is backed by both formal education and hands-on experience in the biotech industry. I've also self-taught various programming languages to enhance my data analysis skills.
